t: The Site Bolden work trousers combine a slim fit with breathable, durable fabric built to handle tough working conditions. Cordura-reinforced knee pad pockets and triple-stitched seams offer enhanced protection against wear and tear. Multiple pockets, including reinforced holster pockets, a free-swing thigh pocket, and a hammer strap, keep essential tools within easy reach. Reflective detailing on the front and back improves visibility in low-light conditions. Machine washable for easy care.
